definitions.explanation: A positive feeling or impression toward someone or something. Often used to describe the initial positive reaction people have toward a person, brand, or behavior.

examples.english: I took a liking to him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誠実|せいじつ}→誠実：14211_seijitsu⟧な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{好感|こうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たれる→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: A sincere attitude earns a favorable impression.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{芸能人|げいのうじん}→芸能人：14959_geinoujin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{好感度|こうかんど}⟦ランキング→ランキング：11195_rankingu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上位|じょうい}→上位：11188_joui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: That celebrity is always near the top of the likability rankings.

notes:
USAGE:
The most common patterns are {好感|こうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have a favorable feeling toward) and {好感|こうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{持|も}てる→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to be able to feel favorable toward). The compound {好感度|こうかんど} (likability rating) is widely used in media.
Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧ (exchange).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {好感|こうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to feel favorably toward)
- {好感|こうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{持|も}てる→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to find likable)
- {好感|こうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧ (to harbor a favorable feeling — more formal)
- {好感度|こうかんど} (likability; favorability rating)
- {好感度|こうかんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (to have high likability)
